item.title: Iran’s last line of resistance holds back — but Houthi terror group warns it’s ready to act
item.summary: Yemen expert reveals why Iran-backed Houthis haven't joined Iran conflict yet – and warns they could attack Saudi Arabia if conflict widens across region.

item.title: Longtime Trump critic reveals why she thinks his Iran actions are wrong, warns it's a 'much bigger war'
item.summary: The U.S. strikes in Iran prompted fierce Democrat-led criticism, including from Rep. Jayapal, who argued Trump violated congressional authorities under the U.S. Constitution.

item.title: King Charles to address 'increasing pressures of conflict' in speech as Trump criticizes British PM on Iran
item.summary: King Charles will deliver a Commonwealth Day message about "pressures of conflict" following President Trump's criticism of the U.K.'s refusal to join the strikes against Iran.

item.title: South Carolina pastor describes evacuating members from Middle East after war broke out during Israel trip
item.summary: Dozens of members of Calvary Chapel Summerville traveled to Israel to explore the Holy Land, but were stranded after Operation Epic Fury launched just hours before their flight home.

item.title: North Carolina mom's 24-year disappearance uncovers silent crisis inside American families
item.summary: A psychologist said Michele Hundley Smith’s 24-year disappearance may reflect family stress that made vanishing feel like the only escape — a silent crisis many families face.

item.title: Dog walkers trigger archaeological race to preserve 2,000-year-old footprints in shifting sands
item.summary: Dog walkers discovered rare 2,000-year-old footprints on a Scottish beach, sparking an urgent archaeological race and rescue before winter storms destroyed the site.

item.title: Ancient herb known as ‘nature’s Valium’ touted for improving sleep and anxiety
item.summary: Experts weigh in on valerian root being called "nature's Valium" for anxiety, stress and sleep issues, warning that the comparison may be misleading for users.

item.title: Kyle Schwarber leads Team USA to 9-1 World Baseball Classic win over Britain
item.summary: Team USA steamrolled Britain 9-1 in the World Baseball Classic Saturday night, improving to 2-0 in Pool B at Houston.

item.title: Exiled Iranian crown prince says regime is 'crumbling' after killing of Khamenei, other leaders
item.summary: Exiled Iranian Crown Prince Reza Pahlavi declares the Islamic Republic is "crumbling" following the death of Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei.

item.title: America’s boys need noble masculinity — not lowered expectations
item.summary: America needs to rebuild conditions that form boys into men through mentorship, restored standards and noble masculinity to address this growing crisis.
